Title: We’re retiring Network Performance Monitor on 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
Because the new Connection Monitor in Azure Network Watcher enhances your monitoring experience, we retire Network Performance monitor on 29 February 2024. We encourage you to start using the new Connection Monitor in Network Watcher to create new tests and take advantage of the enhanced functionality. 

Action required 

Starting 1 July 2021, you will not be able to add new tests in existing workspace or enable new workspace in Network Performance Monitor. You can continue to use the tests created prior to 1 July 2021. To minimize service disruption to your current workloads, please migrate your tests from Network Performance Monitor to the new Connection Monitor in Azure Network Watcher before 29 February 2024. 

More information 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
